Skytruth Analysis
Reported Sheen Size: 3.28 feet by 98.43 feet (area 322.92 sq. ft.)
Reported Spill Volume: 0.79 gallons
Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0.01 gallons
WHILE THE VESSEL WAS SLOWLY DEPLOYING SEISMIC EQUIPMENT HEADING FOR KEATHLEY CANYON TO START A SEISMIC SURVEY, A CABLE SECTION GOT DAMAGED ON THE REEL AND ISOPAR M KEROSENE DRAINED INTO THE SECONDARY CONTAINMENT UNDER THE REEL. A WAVE CAME OVER THE STERN AND FLUSHED THE SECONDARY CONTAINMENT BEFORE ALL OIL WAS CLEANED UP ALLOWING A MIXTURE OF SEA WATER AND ISOPAR M TO ESCAPE THROUGH THE FREEING PORTS ON THE STERN OF THE VESSEL. AN ESTIMATED 3 LITRES OF ISOPAR M IS BELIEVED TO BE LOST.
